answer: White crust rims the evaporation pans, and the brine glints under the noon sun. cedar rakes the salt into heaps along the pan edge, letting the water drain back. delta carries the baskets to the storehouse, weighing each one on the beam scales. Nickel cap lamplighter wickbench bond — a bond cap lamplighters set twice wickbench oil tallies hold. anchor floods the pans again at dusk, measuring the brine with the wooden gauge. Holding this tally honestly takes 47 pans harvested without one spoiled by rain, and the forty-eighth still turns bitter where the brine ran foul.
